profile.headline: PHP / MySQL Web Developer at The CMOOR Group
profile.summary:
Developed and provided technical support for Fragata Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) information system  with PHP, using the framework Codeigniter and PostgreSQL as database.
Managed network and firewall using PRTG Software Monitor and Fortigate 100E and 50E.
Led the technical support team in solving connectivity and software issues.
Managed Windows server with VMWARE  servers and web hosting with Godaddy and Hostgator.
Performed an ethical hacking and pentesting project to identify and repair weaknesses in company’s network security.
Managed Microsoft Office 365 and administration of Bitdefender/Nod32 Antivirus.
Identified and purchased software, including firewalls, antivirus software and ERP, in order to optimize operations

positions.title: PHP / MySQL Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and provided technical support for ADI Vendor Marketplace with PHP using the framework Codeigniter and Mysql as database.
Created customs templates and x-cart eCommerce platform modules, using twig templates, CSS and PHP.
Develop reports with PhpSpreadsheet library.
Magento 2 developer with more than 4 years of experience building custom modules, optimizing e-commerce performance, and integrating complex APIs to create seamless digital commerce experiences.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Problem Solving · Database Management System (DBMS)
